wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: the refusal contract is any client error with no file read, so a crash on the blocked path is an acceptable refusal; a crash on a legitimate in-directory reference is caught by the functional tests.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the sink reads a single resource kind (a file named by a path); there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise instead.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: a file read has no role, peer or direction dimension, so there is nothing to fix for only one of them.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected sink is an arbitrary file read; there is no write counterpart to this flaw in scope.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the reference is a plain filesystem path, not a parsed identity whose malformed spelling could make the guard see nothing.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: containment is purely path-based; there is no external authority that could return no secret/role and make the guard fail open.
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: each sink is guarded on its own resolved path; no shared helper fix changes a sibling API's stated behaviour.
